title: Why Japanese Cities Have So Many One-Way Streets
seo_title: Why Japanese Cities Have So Many One-Way Streets
description: Dense Japanese neighborhoods often use one-way streets (ippo tsuko) to move cars through grids too narrow for two lanes. Learn why the signs exist, how delivery uses them, and why visitors get lost—without confusing this with missing sidewalks.
